_doc: Every Platform.OS / Platform.select use and every *.web / *.native fork file, classified (device-lab spec J3). A new fork fails lib/device-lab/__tests__/platformForks.test.ts until it is listed here. inherent: keep, with a unit test of the native branch or a residual that says why none exists; removable: make it platform-agnostic; instrumentation: no behaviour.

frontend/mla-tamagui/app/(app)/_layout.t.why: drawer width: a CSS min() string is valid on web only, native computes pixels
frontend/mla-tamagui/app/(app)/_layout.t.residual: style arithmetic; the native arm is Math.min(width * 0.78, 320)

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/c.residual: DOM focus; a WebView on native has no document focus to clear

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/leetcode/p.why: Android resizes the window for the keyboard, iOS does not, so only iOS lifts the composer

frontend/mla-tamagui/features/tamil-writ.residual: U4: the native arm renders Skia directly; no test can run it off a device
